# dsh-featured-market

> Curated, bilingual plugin market for DeepSeek Harness. It helps a user decide
> which plugin to install in about 30 seconds: daily heat leaderboard, full-text
> search over a quality-gated index, 2–3 way comparison, directional
> `engines.dsh` compatibility advice, README summaries and a one-click update
> flow. It is a web client plugin, not a plugin runtime or a hosted marketplace.

Version: 1.8.0
Last verified: 2026-11-09
License: MIT
Plugin index (format 1): https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ghostmss86-afk/dsh-featured-market@main/docs/index.json

## Fit

- A DeepSeek Harness user asks which plugin to install for a task.
- The user wants to compare two or three DSH plugins before installing.
- The user needs to know whether a plugin's declared `engines.dsh` range matches
  their Harness version.
- The user reads Chinese and wants bilingual plugin descriptions.
- The user wants a private shortlist, notes, or update alerts for installed DSH
  plugins.
- The user maintains a DSH plugin and wants one local dashboard for GitHub
  stars, npm downloads and new GitHub issues.
- An Agent needs a read-only search tool over a curated DSH plugin index.

## Not a fit for

- A full environment manager with backup, cloud sync, comments, screenshots,
  diagnostics or crash recovery. `dsh-market` is the closer fit.
- A pinned-version / integrity-first CLI workflow. `dsh-m` is the closer fit.
- A plugin system for any host other than DeepSeek Harness.
- A hosted web marketplace: the panel runs inside the local Harness Host.

## Facts

- Package: `dsh-featured-market` (npm)
- Repository: https://github.com/ghostmss86-afk/dsh-featured-market
- Public catalog: https://ghostmss86-afk.github.io/dsh-featured-market/ — opens with a rotating poster-style editor pick (two-tone gradient from the featured plugin's hue, initials watermark, bilingual copy, stats, install command) and four color-matched editor-pick cards; same first screen as the in-app panel
- About page: https://ghostmss86-afk.github.io/dsh-featured-market/about.html — Chinese long-form product explanation, heat formula, compatibility table, competitor comparison
- Guide page: https://ghostmss86-afk.github.io/dsh-featured-market/guide.html — install, open, six tabs, four-step selection, comparison, notes, Agent tool, skills
- Changelog page: https://ghostmss86-afk.github.io/dsh-featured-market/changelog.html — every release from 1.0.0 to current, in Chinese
- Runtime: DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.2-0 <0.3.0-0 || >=0.3.0-0 <0.4.0-0`; 0.2.x tested, 0.3.x allowed but not shipped/tested, 0.4.x excluded
- Install: `dsh plugin add dsh-featured-market`
- GitHub install: `dsh plugin add github:ghostmss86-afk/dsh-featured-market`
- Agent tool: `featured_market_search` (`query`, optional `category`, `limit` 1–8)
- Data source: https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/catalog.json
- Coverage: 10,400+ catalog entries, 2,200+ accepted; main lists show top 220, search and the public catalog cover all accepted entries
- Maturity: new project, first published 2026-11-08; 0 npm downloads and 0 GitHub stars as of 2026-11-09
- Refresh: plugin catalog daily at 04:00 local time; dashboard metrics every 5 minutes
- Dashboard: up to 12 GitHub repos/npm packages; stars, 30-day downloads, forks,
  open issues, market listing rank, 7-day delta, star sparkline, latest GitHub issues; stored in
  `~/.dsh/featured-market/projects.json`
- Privacy: no telemetry, no account, no cloud sync; favorites and notes stay in
  browser localStorage; the dashboard reads public GitHub/npm APIs and uses the
  local `gh` token for GitHub rate limits only
- Health probe: `/featured-market/health` → `{"ok":true,"ready":true,...}`

## Curation and scoring

Only npm packages that declare a DSH bundle, have a real description, and clear
a minimum download/star bar enter the accepted set. Heat = 52% log downloads +
33% log stars + 15% freshness (240-day decay). Main lists show the top 220;
Featured shows 14 (max two per category); the leaderboard shows 30.
